apps.hint: Switch parts of Ziira on or off for your business. Switching off keeps your data; removing deletes it.
apps.loadFailed: The list of apps could not be loaded.
apps.noneHint: No modules or plugins are offered on this system yet. Ask your Ziira operator.
apps.unavailableHint: Not available yet: ask your Ziira operator.
apps.enableAsk: {{name}} will be switched on and its screens and menus will appear.
apps.enableAlso: These will be switched on as well because {{name}} needs them: {{names}}.
apps.disableAsk: Its screens and menus will disappear for everyone in the business. Your data is kept, and comes back when you switch it on again.
apps.removeAsk: This permanently deletes everything {{name}} has stored for this business. It cannot be undone. If you switch it on again later it starts empty.

edition.addsNothing: Everything it includes is already on.
edition.keeps: Nothing you have is switched off or deleted. To switch something off later, use its card below.
